title: Say Inngaran ed Sankaabungan na Propeta
intro: Diad sankaabungan na unor a mensahero, walay manaayam a kamarerwa a say personal ya istorya to so nagmaliw a madibinon leksion parad amin a mananisia. Say bilay na sayan too et maapit a misiglaotan ed sakey a makapanguman a ganggan ya anguman ed saray kustombre na sosyedad ed andi-anggaan, a mamaneknek na baleg a pananguman ed no panon a say pananisia so mangiter na kabaliksan ed pamilya tan inkaapag-apag.
clues: Say ngaran ko et datin nisiglaot ed sakey a noble a poli, balet say mas atagey a katuaan so mamalinew ed saginonor ed saray tuan bedber na pananisia.
Siak so akaawat na baleg a pabor manlapud si Allah tan say mensahero To, sakey a pabor ya inyabawag ed publiko ed Libro.
Say bilay ko bilang sanasawa so nagmaliw ya importantin subok ya manguman ed andi-anggaan so panmoria ed saray inampon a relasyon.
Siak so sakey ya say personal a subok to so angitonton ed sakey a madibinon ganggan ya angiyabuloy ed Propeta a mangasawa na sakey a bii kayari na itaynan ko.
Diad panamegley na istoryak, say pandumaan na biolohikal tan pinilin pamilya et alinewan ed amin a kailalakan.
Siak labat ed saray kaedaran ko so ngaran ko ya malinew ya pinmatnag ed unor a panangiparungtal, aliwan bilang sakey a propeta, noagta bilang sakey ya aripen ya asubok tan pinagalangan.

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Say pangangga ed panag-ampon bilang paraan pian nawalaan na relasyon ed dala
Say inkiletneg na sankaunaan ya estado na Islam
outcome.answer: Say pangangga ed panag-ampon bilang paraan pian nawalaan na relasyon ed dala

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
